items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: I never called him His Highness, he called me Sonny and I'd say, yeah, man, I am talking just like I'm talking to you.

ctx.x: So right away he pick up on my name, Sonny, so after awhile, he say, 'I can play the drum.' I say 'Yeah, come on man,' me and him tight now. We're juicing together. 'Go on and play, go ahead.' He say, 'I play the Charleston.' Play, ba, bab, you know, playing. I say 'Yeah, man, that's great.' So then (singing) I showed him how to play it fancy, and he said, 'Man, that's fine, can you show me that.' I say 'anytime,' still guzzling.

Now the people, the women start drifting by and they see this cat drifting by and I see all these women bow to this son of a bitch, curtsy you know, I say this cat must be -- and so the guy -- the waiter come up and say, 'Your Highness, some people want to see you.' You know who he was, the Prince of Wales. I never called him His Highness, he called me Sonny and I'd say, yeah, man, I am talking just like I'm talking to you.
I said, 'oh, you're the Prince of Wales.' He's heir to the throne.
